title: The Works of Philo Judaeus
author: Philo of Alexandria; tr. Charles Duke Yonge

translation.name: The Works of Philo Judaeus — Philo of Alexandria

rights: Public domain (Yonge d. 1891; published 1854–55). Scan and OCR: Internet Archive, University of Toronto.
citation: Philo Judaeus. The Works of Philo Judaeus, the Contemporary of Josephus. Tr. C. D. Yonge. 4 vols. London: Henry G. Bohn, 1854–55. Public domain; Internet Archive scans (Toronto).
editorialMarkers: Philo of Alexandria — the Jewish philosopher of Roman Egypt — in Yonge’s Victorian translation: allegorical commentary on Genesis and Exodus, the Life of Moses, the Special Laws and the historical treatises. Section numbers are Yonge’s; the translation predates the modern Loeb numbering.
method: Internet Archive OCR text per volume; treatises open at a capitalised title block (“A TREATISE …”, “THE nth BOOK OF THE TREATISE …”); paragraphs by blank lines; page numbers, lone running heads and volume signatures dropped; hyphenation joined; the index and catalogue matter cut. OCR errors are not corrected.
